liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Scarlet Begonias** (3 reviews): Giant beachball landed in front of Jerry during the buildup; Scarlet, Touch, and Fire played at warp speed with high energy [24][28][31]
- **Stella Blue** (2 reviews): Giant soap bubble hung over Jerry's head during the final part; Reviewer describes the performance as having plaintiff bleating [24][30]
- **Dark Star** (2 reviews): Accompanied by a slide show and a shooting star overhead; Reviewer praises the exceptional interplay between all band members [24][34]
- **The Wheel** (1 review): Jerry's jam from Space into Wheel features bizarre electronic buzzing [27]

## The recordings

- **gd84-07-13.sbd.ferguson.353.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 20 songs; 154 min; rated 4.53/5 by 60 [1]. Said about its sound: Reviewer notes the recording has nice sound quality; Ferguson notes background hiss suggests the source had an analog generation [1][31]
- **gd1984-07-13.sbd.walker-scotton.miller.96153.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 20 songs; 154 min; rated 4.08/5 by 13 [5]
- **gd1984-07-13.sbd.ferguson.joshd.fix-353.90464.flac16**: soundboard; 20 songs; 155 min; rated 3.5/5 by 10 [6]. Said about its sound: Encore pitch differs from rest of show, requiring separate correction [6]
- **gd1984-07-13.mtx.seamons.105570.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 20 songs; 155 min; rated 4.42/5 by 12 [2]

## Around the show

- Reviewer suspects band members ingested something during intermission before the second set [29]
- Listener played tape for people in line at Middletown, NY who missed it [32]
- Reviewer recalls the most energetic Greek crowd they had ever seen [34]
- Show occurred on Friday the 13th with a full moon [35]
- Democratic and Moral Majority conventions were in town that week [35]
- Shooting star appeared over the stage during the start of Dark Star [4]
- Reviewer calls the Wheel jam the best they have ever heard [27]
- Reviewer calls the Dark Star possibly their favorite post-hiatus version [28]
- Reviewer rates this show better than other Greek Theatre shows that year [29]
- Reviewer cites this as proof of great music in the mid-80s [30]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd84-07-13.sbd.ferguson.353.sbeok.shnf**: source: SBD > ? > CDR> DAE (cdparanoia)> SHN [1]. Also: Source lineage includes SBD, unknown, CDR, DAE, and SHN via Mark Ferguson [1]
- **gd1984-07-13.sbd.walker-scotton.miller.96153.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Joani Walker and Paul Scotton; transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Cassette Master (Sony D6/Maxell XLII-S90/TDK MA90) [5]. Also: Bertha and Greatest Story Ever Told patched from first generation cassette [5]
- **gd1984-07-13.sbd.ferguson.joshd.fix-353.90464.flac16**: transferred by Speed Correction by joshd; source: SBD > ? > CDR [6]
- **gd1984-07-13.mtx.seamons.105570.flac16**: transferred by Hunter Seamons; source: Matrix using Final Cut Pro (FLAC>AIFF>Final Cut>WAV>FLAC) [2]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by gratefuldeadshirt.org: [Grateful Dead Shirt T Shirt Vintage 1984 Greek Theatre UC Berkeley Cal CA GDP L | Grateful Dead Shirt](https://gratefuldeadshirt.org/grateful-dead-shirt-t-shirt-vintage-1984-greek-theatre-uc-berkeley-cal-ca-gdp-l/) [37]
- Poster by Jerry Garcia: [1984-07-13 Backstage Pass - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/image/1984-07-13-backstage-pass/) [38]
- Poster by Steven Rood Grateful Dead: [1984-07-15 Greek Theatre, Berkeley, CA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1984-07-15-greek-theatre-berkeley-ca/) [39]
